facts.model_weight_precision: mixed NVFP4 and BF16 per checkpoint quantization exclusions

model.input_ids.equation: token_ids := request token ids with shape [B,T]

model.embedding.equation: X = Embedding[token_ids], Embedding in R^(V x H)

model.decoder_stack.equation: Y = DecoderStack_78(X; dense layers 0..2, MoE layers 3..77)

model.optional_nextn_extension.equation: draft_logits = NextN(candidate_token_ids, target_hidden_state) when speculative generation is enabled

stack.layer_schedule.equation: for l in 0..77: apply DenseMLP when l < 3; otherwise apply RoutedSharedMoE

decoder.dsa_attention.equation: Delta_attn, cache_next, topk_state_next = DSA_MLA(X_attn, cache_prev, topk_state_prev)

decoder.feed_forward_schedule.equation: Delta_ffn = DenseMLP(X_ffn) if l < 3 else RoutedSharedMoE(X_ffn)

dsa_attention.q_a_projection.equation: Q_latent = X W_qa^T in R^(B x T x 2048)

dsa_attention.kv_a_projection.equation: [C_kv,K_rope] = X W_kva^T with widths Ckv and Drope

dsa_attention.q_split_rope.equation: Q = Concat(Q_nope, RoPE(Q_rope)) along the head channel axis

dsa_attention.latent_kv_reconstruction.equation: K_nope = C_kv_norm W_kc^T; V = C_kv_norm W_vc^T

dsa_attention.indexer_schedule.equation: compute index top-k on 21 owner layers; reuse the latest top-k state on 57 shared layers

dsa_attention.index_topk_state.equation: topk_state_next := selected_positions on owner layers; shared layers read topk_state_prev

dsa_attention.output_projection.equation: Delta_attn = Reshape(C) W_o^T in R^(B x T x H)

dense_mlp.down_projection.equation: Delta_ffn = M W_down^T in R^(B x T x H)

moe.router.equation: router_logits = X W_router^T in R^(B x T x E)

moe.dispatch.equation: X_e = Dispatch(X, expert_ids) grouped by routed expert

moe.routed_experts.equation: Y_e = W_down_e(SiLU(W_gate_e X_e) elementwise_mul (W_up_e X_e)) for e in 0..255

mtp.eh_projection.equation: X_draft = EH W_eh^T, mapping 2H to H
